milestones.label: A2A portal opens for ICCR 2026-27 applications (date differs by embassy notice)
milestones.source_text: Indian missions give different opening dates: 27 February 2026 on the Maputo High Commission notice and 23 February 2026 on the Chicago Consulate General notice.

milestones.label: Application deadline for ICCR 2026-27 (differs by scheme and mission)
milestones.time_text: 15 April 2026 in the Maitri timeline; 31 May 2026 for the AYUSH scheme
milestones.source_text: The Maputo notice lists 15 April 2026 as the student deadline for the India-Africa Maitri scheme, and the Warsaw embassy gives 31 May 2026 for the AYUSH scheme, so applicants should check their own Indian mission.
